_comment: Editorial decisions for the generated MCP files, from a web fact-check (2026-10). Keys are '<category>-<id>' from data/sitedata.js. The site's own data is left untouched because each attraction page renders by looking its record up by id; these decisions only affect what scripts/generate-mcp.mjs publishes. 'exclude' drops the record; 'district'/'locality' relabel it; 'withhold' nulls fields that the check showed to be wrong.

shopping-77.exclude: Not an attraction: a BEVCO liquor outlet

museums-27.exclude: Could not be located as a Wayanad attraction

romantic-48.exclude: Could not be located in Wayanad (possibly a different Manjappara in Idukki)

romantic-83.exclude: No place by this name could be found

culthist-1.exclude: No Santhinatha temple in Wayanad could be found

romantic-76.exclude: Placeholder record sharing another place's coordinates; unidentifiable

romantic-22.exclude: Record does not match its page (Karapuzha Dam) and its coordinates sit on Pookode Lake

museums-89.exclude: Planned museum near Periya; coordinates were copied from the Tea Museum

shopping-67.exclude: Unidentifiable sub-entry of En Ooru with coordinates in Kalpetta town

waterfalls-34.exclude: Duplicate of Soochipara Falls (Sentinel Rock is the same place)

waterfalls-38.exclude: No source found; coordinates are 0.2 km from Kanthanpara Falls

romantic-56.exclude: Duplicate of Lakkidi Ghats View Point (trucking-20); same page and coordinates

waterfalls-40.note: Aripara Falls is in Kozhikode district, not Wayanad

waterfalls-16.note: Thusharagiri Falls is in Kozhikode district, not Wayanad

waterfalls-41.note: Iruppu Falls is in Kodagu, Karnataka; the Brahmagiri trek needs a Karnataka Forest permit and guide

wildlife-29.note: Nagarhole is a national park in Karnataka, not a Wayanad sanctuary

culthist-6.note: Located in Pulpally rather than Sultan Bathery

farms-88.note: North Wayanad; the stated 10 km from Kalpetta is doubtful

romantic-75.note: The real place is near Thalappuzha, more than 40 km away; stated coordinates are in Kalpetta

romantic-58.note: Stated coordinates are about 7.5 km from the real location

pilgrimage-3.note: Stated coordinates conflict with the ~20 km road distance in Kerala Tourism

waterfalls-36.note: Shares coordinates with Chetalayam Falls and is likely the same place

plantation-80.note: No source found for a visitor-facing estate by this name; verify before recommending
